classification_method: Real bounded clinical judgment applied once per discovered chunk, using only structural metadata (subheading/tn_node_id/page), not chapter prose. Each chunk received exactly one earliest cheap-filter outcome from the Phase-11 enumeration. A chunk naming no specific competing action/diagnosis (a process heading, an off-topic chapter sibling, a pagination artifact, or content that is foundational source material for the key itself rather than a competitor) is OTHER_CHEAP_REJECTION; this is the same 'chapter-sibling noise' failure mode already documented for Fresh-Holdout-18/24, not a new rejection category.

discovery_precision_finding: Consistent with the H18/H24 root-cause finding: blanket TN chapter-adjacency (subheading-level BM25 over the learner-decision sentence) is dominated by off-topic or non-actionable chapter-sibling noise (29/40 = 72.5% OTHER_CHEAP_REJECTION). Of the 8 opportunities, 2 (RDY-PHELO-02, RDY-PHELO-08) produced zero survivors -- both are the two opportunities whose response_class axis was already flagged in the opportunity-semantics review as a forced generic-token fallback with no dedicated archetype, and their raw chunks were either foundational source material for the key itself or too generic to name a distinct competing action without reading protected chapter text.
partial_reason: The 4 SURVIVES_TO_SEMANTIC candidates (RDY-PED-04 x1, RDY-SURG-03 x1, RDY-PSY-03 x2) each still require the same per-candidate depth every comparable prior session in this project's history gave a smaller slice of the same work: bounded clinical plausibility screening, relation authoring (Clinical Contrast Relation V2 with positive anchor, inferiority discriminator, second-key analysis), targeted evidence verification, one fresh independent seed/relation/anchor review, and -- only if a seed pack and contrast set survive -- conditional generation, blind solve, and final independent medical review. Compressing that into the same pass as discovery would mean materially less scrutiny of safety-critical medical content than this project's own established practice requires (see the Fresh-Holdout-24 contamination this project already had to diagnose and repair after exactly this kind of compression). Reported PARTIAL, not fabricated.
